papers.title: Chemical Reaction Rates from Ring Polymer Molecular Dynamics: Zero Point Energy Conservation in Mu + H2 → MuH + H
papers.publisher_access_result: Public indexed publisher metadata and abstract available; publisher page states Available to Purchase. Direct web retrieval returned HTTP 403.

author_repository.access_document_links: Publisher DOI only; no manuscript or PDF download link found in the retrieved landing-page HTML. The hidden generic preview placeholder does not establish a downloadable manuscript.

verified_primary_facts: The published abstract attributes the close RPMD/quantum agreement chiefly to zero-point energy and describes tunneling as a minor contribution.
papers.interpretation: The abstract supports a zero-point-energy conservation benchmark. This paper alone does not justify describing Mu + H2 as a deep-tunneling stress test.
